title: Ring strict henselization relative to a chosen separable residue closure
statement: Let $A$ be a local commutative ring with residue field $k=A/\mathfrak m_A$, and let $K$ be a separable algebraic extension of $k$ that is separably closed [def-pc-separably-closed], regarded as an $A$-algebra via $A\to k\to K$. An $A$-algebra $C$ is a strict henselization of $A$ relative to $K$ if it is isomorphic as an $A$-algebra to the vertex of a universal colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] for the forgetful diagram from the category of pairs $(S,\chi)$, where $S$ is an etale $A$-algebra (that is, $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]) and $\chi:S\to K$ is an $A$-algebra map. A morphism $(S,\chi)\to(S^{\prime},\chi^{\prime})$ is an $A$-algebra map $\beta:S\to S^{\prime}$ satisfying $\chi^{\prime}\circ\beta=\chi$. The diagram takes $(S,\chi)$ to $S$ and takes $\beta$ to itself. All algebras are in a common arbitrary universe; the etale category is essentially small by finite presentation.
